title: Hybrid networking — VPN, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink
topic: Site-to-Site VPN vs Direct Connect, DX+VPN failover, Transit Gateway hub-spoke, VPC peering non-transitive routing, PrivateLink vs VPC endpoints, on-prem to Night 9 VPC scenarios
format: 15 timed scenario questions (~24 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces night-21-hybrid-networking.md. Theory night — no lab deploy. Answer without peeking at night-21-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×4 B×4 C×4 D×3 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: Resort HQ (192.168.0.0/16) must reach saa-study-gsa-vpc (10.0.0.0/16) this week over the public internet with encrypted tunnels. No dedicated fiber yet. Fastest AWS hybrid option?

options.A: AWS Site-to-Site VPN — IPSec from customer gateway to virtual private gateway or Transit Gateway
options.B: AWS Direct Connect with a 10 Gbps dedicated port
options.C: VPC peering between the data center LAN and the VPC
options.D: AWS PrivateLink interface endpoint in the on-prem rack

questions.question: Leadership requires consistent sub-10 ms jitter and 5 Gbps sustained throughput from on-prem ETL to Aurora in private subnets. Public internet variability is unacceptable. Primary link?

options.A: Site-to-Site VPN with accelerated VPN only
options.B: NAT Gateway in the public subnet with port forwarding
options.C: Internet Gateway attached to the database subnet route table
options.D: AWS Direct Connect private virtual interface to the VPC or Transit Gateway

questions.question: You already have Direct Connect as the primary hybrid path. The exam asks for resilience when the DX circuit fails. Standard companion service?

options.A: Replace DX with a second Internet Gateway in the VPC
options.B: Site-to-Site VPN as backup terminating on the same Transit Gateway or virtual private gateway
options.C: VPC peering to a second Direct Connect location in another Region
options.D: Public VIF only — drop private VIF during outages

questions.question: Twelve VPCs across three accounts must all reach on-prem 172.16.0.0/12 and a shared inspection VPC. Full mesh VPC peering is rejected. Hub design?

options.A: Transit Gateway with attachments per VPC and centralized route tables
options.B: One Site-to-Site VPN per VPC to duplicate customer gateways
options.C: PrivateLink interface endpoint in every spoke VPC for each resource
options.D: Inter-Region VPC peering only — no hybrid connectivity

questions.question: VPC A peers with VPC B. VPC B peers with VPC C. Apps in VPC A must reach RDS in VPC C by private IP. Will peering alone work?

options.A: Yes — peering is transitive across three VPCs automatically
options.B: Yes — if all three use the same CIDR block
options.C: No — VPC peering is non-transitive; A needs its own peering or a Transit Gateway path to C
options.D: No — peering only works within one AWS account

questions.question: A third-party ski-analytics API runs in the vendor's AWS account. Your Fargate tasks in saa-study-gsa-vpc must call it without traversing the public internet. Vendor offers AWS PrivateLink. Pattern?

options.A: Site-to-Site VPN from your VPC to the vendor's office
options.B: VPC peering between 10.0.0.0/16 and the vendor VPC with merged route tables
options.C: Interface VPC endpoint (consumer) in your subnets to the vendor's endpoint service behind their NLB
options.D: S3 Gateway endpoint in the private subnet route table

questions.question: Fargate tasks in Night 9 private subnets upload pipeline artifacts to S3 without NAT charges for that traffic. Which Night 8 pattern still applies — not PrivateLink to a third party?

options.A: AWS PrivateLink to a partner-published S3 endpoint service
options.B: S3 Gateway VPC endpoint associated with the private subnet route table
options.C: Direct Connect public VIF as the only option for S3
options.D: Client VPN on each Fargate task ENI

questions.question: On-prem and AWS both use 10.0.0.0/16. You attempt Site-to-Site VPN to saa-study-gsa-vpc. BGP never installs usable routes. Root cause?

options.A: Overlapping CIDR blocks — hybrid routing cannot distinguish identical prefixes
options.B: VPN requires exactly one tunnel — delete the second tunnel
options.C: Virtual private gateway must be in a public subnet
options.D: Direct Connect is mandatory when CIDRs match

questions.question: Direct Connect private VIF terminates on a Direct Connect Gateway. Multiple VPCs in us-east-1 must receive on-prem routes. Common next hop from DX Gateway?

options.B: NAT Gateway in every availability zone
options.C: Transit Gateway — DX Gateway associates with TGW for multi-VPC hybrid hub
options.D: AWS PrivateLink endpoint service per VPC

questions.question: Compare encryption defaults on the exam. Which statement is correct?

options.A: Direct Connect encrypts all traffic with IPSec by default
options.B: Transit Gateway encrypts all inter-VPC traffic with customer-managed KMS keys by default
options.C: VPC peering traffic crosses the public internet unless you enable PrivateLink
options.D: Site-to-Site VPN uses IPSec over the internet; DX is a private layer-2/path — add VPN over DX if encryption is required

questions.question: Night 16 Aurora must accept PostgreSQL only from on-prem BI hosts (192.168.50.0/24) and Lambda in the same VPC — not the internet. Hybrid is already up via TGW. Security control?

options.A: Aurora security group: allow TCP 5432 from on-prem CIDR and from the Lambda security group
options.B: Enable Aurora public accessibility and restrict NACL to 192.168.50.0/24
options.C: Attach an Internet Gateway to the DB subnet for BI traffic
options.D: Replace hybrid with CloudFront origin for port 5432

questions.question: Two dev teams need bidirectional private IP connectivity between vpc-dev (10.2.0.0/16) and vpc-staging (10.3.0.0/16) in the same Region. No SaaS endpoint service involved. Simplest fit?

options.A: AWS PrivateLink with the staging team publishing every EC2 as an endpoint service
options.B: VPC peering with reciprocal routes for each other's CIDR
options.C: Site-to-Site VPN between the two VPCs
options.D: Direct Connect hosted connection between dev and staging only

questions.question: A shared-services account owns a Transit Gateway. Spoke VPCs in other accounts must attach. Which AWS feature shares the TGW without moving the VPCs?

options.A: AWS Organizations SCP that copies route tables
options.B: VPC peering from every spoke to the management account only
options.C: AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM) share of the Transit Gateway

questions.question: night-21-hybrid-networking.md is a theory night with $0 deploy. What hands-on artifact should you produce tonight?

options.A: Run night-21-lab-vpn-setup.ps1 to create a customer gateway
options.B: Three paper diagrams: on-prem→VPC hybrid, multi-VPC TGW hub, SaaS via PrivateLink
options.C: Delete saa-study-gsa-vpc to avoid NAT charges before Week 3 review
options.D: Enable Aurora public accessibility for VPN testing

questions.question: Remote engineers on laptops need encrypted access to resources in saa-study-gsa-vpc — not a data-center site link. Service?

options.A: Site-to-Site VPN with one tunnel per laptop
options.B: Direct Connect hosted connection per engineer
options.C: VPC peering to the corporate hotel Wi-Fi
options.D: AWS Client VPN (or similar remote-access VPN) — per-user, not Site-to-Site VPN
